section.content: The invention relates to the technical field of binders, in particular to a carboxymethyl cellulose sodium derivative water-based binder containing a carbamate structural unit, and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the sodium carboxymethyl cellulose derivative water-based binder containing the carbamate structural unit comprises the steps of adding a cross-linking agent isocyanate monomer A and a solvent into sodium carboxymethyl cellulose water solution, and performing thermal polymerization reaction at a certain temperature to obtain the water-based binder. The invention introduces the isocyanate crosslinking agent with high reactivity to realize the transition of CMC from a linear structure to a net structure, and simultaneously, carbamate groups in the structure can form certain hydrogen bond interaction, thereby effectively improving the mechanical property, the adhesive property, the stability and the electrochemical property of the adhesive. So that it can better adapt to the volume expansion of Si particles.

本发明涉及粘结剂技术领域，尤其涉及一种含有氨基甲酸酯结构单元的羧甲基纤维素钠衍生物类水系粘结剂及其制备方法和应用。一种含有氨基甲酸酯结构单元的羧甲基纤维素钠衍生物类水系粘结剂的制备方法为，在羧甲基纤维素钠水溶液中加入交联剂异氰酸酯类单体A和溶剂，并在一定温度下进行热聚合反应，即可制得该水系粘结剂。本发明引入高反应性的异氰酸酯交联剂实现CMC从线性到网状的结构转变，同时结构中的氨基甲酸酯集团能形成一定氢键相互作用，能有效提高粘结剂的力学性能、粘结性能、稳定性以及电化学性能。使其能够更好的适应Si颗粒的体积膨胀。

Sodium carboxymethyl cellulose derivative water-based binder containing carbamate structural unit, and preparation method and application thereofTechnical Field

The invention relates to the technical field of binders, in particular to a carboxymethyl cellulose sodium derivative water-based binder containing a carbamate structural unit, and a preparation method and application thereof.

Background

Silicon negative electrode material is an important material in lithium ion battery, and silicon has higher theoretical specific capacity compared with the traditional graphite negative electrode. The theoretical specific capacity of silicon is up to 3579 mAh/g, and the theoretical specific capacity of graphite is 372 mAh/g, so that the silicon cathode has the potential to provide higher energy density, thereby improving the overall performance of the battery, and particularly in the application fields of electric automobiles, large-scale energy storage and the like. However, during the charge and discharge of the lithium ion battery, the silicon negative electrode material undergoes a great volume change of about 300%. Such volume expansion and contraction can lead to failure of the negative electrode material in contact with the electrolyte, electrode current collector, thereby causing capacity fade, cycle performance degradation, and even mechanical breakage of the battery.

Related studies have shown that suitable binders not only can buffer the stress when the silicon particles expand, but also can improve electron transport between the silicon and the current collector, achieving a more robust electrode structure. In addition, the existing battery preparation process is not changed by the updating of the binder, and the binder is less in usage ratio, low in cost and more acceptable to the market. Therefore, the development of a high-performance binder that more closely matches a high specific capacity silicon-based negative electrode has become an important subject of research in the related art.

Disclosure of Invention

The invention aims at overcoming the defects of the prior art and provides a sodium carboxymethyl cellulose derivative water-based adhesive containing carbamate structural units, and a preparation method and application thereof.

The first object of the present invention is to provide a preparation method of a carboxymethyl cellulose sodium derivative water-based adhesive containing carbamate structural units, wherein a crosslinking agent isocyanate monomer A and a solvent are added into a carboxymethyl cellulose sodium aqueous solution, and a thermal polymerization reaction is performed at a certain temperature to obtain the water-based adhesive.

Further, the concentration of the sodium carboxymethyl cellulose aqueous solution is 0.01-0.10 g/mL.

Further, the monomer A accounts for 1-10mol% of the sodium carboxymethyl cellulose aqueous solution.

Further, the monomer A is one or more of hexamethylene diisocyanate, diphenylmethane diisocyanate, 1, 5-naphthalene diisocyanate and dimethylbiphenyl diisocyanate.

Further, the thermal polymerization reaction time is 1-3 hours, and the temperature is 70-90 ℃.

The second object of the present invention is to provide a sodium carboxymethyl cellulose derivative aqueous binder containing a carbamate structural unit prepared by the above-mentioned preparation method.

The third object of the invention is to provide a lithium ion battery anode material, which comprises the sodium carboxymethyl cellulose derivative water-based binder of the carbamate structural unit.

Further, the grain size of the silicon powder is 60-100 nm, the conductive additive is one or more of acetylene black, ketjen black, super P and carbon nano tubes, and the mass ratio of the silicon powder to the conductive additive to the water-based binder is 50-70:30-20:20-10.

The technical scheme provided by the invention has the beneficial effects that:

1. The invention introduces the isocyanate crosslinking agent with high reactivity to realize the transition of CMC from a linear structure to a net structure, and simultaneously, carbamate groups in the structure can form certain hydrogen bond interaction, thereby effectively improving the mechanical property, the adhesive property, the stability and the electrochemical property of the adhesive. So that it can better adapt to the volume expansion of Si particles.

2. The preparation method of the sodium carboxymethyl cellulose derivative water-based binder containing the carbamate structural unit has simple synthesis conditions, and the reaction solvent is environment-friendly and nontoxic. The binder is based on commercial sodium carboxymethyl cellulose modified material, and the cost is low.

3. The method for preparing the pole piece in situ omits the post-treatment step of the polymer, and is simple and convenient.

Detailed Description

The following are specific embodiments of the present invention and the technical solutions of the present invention will be further described with reference to the accompanying drawings, but the present invention is not limited to these embodiments.

The invention provides a preparation method of a phosphonic acid group-containing water-based covalent crosslinking type polymer binder, which comprises the following steps:

The commercial adhesive sodium carboxymethyl cellulose CMC is dissolved in deionized water, then an isocyanate monomer A is added as a cross-linking agent, acetone is added as a solvent, and cross-linking polymerization reaction is carried out at a certain temperature, so that the covalent cross-linking type reticular adhesive is prepared.

In the present invention, the concentration of sodium carboxymethyl cellulose is 0.01 to 0.10 g/mL, preferably 0.01 to 0.05 g/mL, and more preferably 0.02 g/mL.

In the present invention, the monomer A is one of Hexamethylene Diisocyanate (HDI), diphenylmethane diisocyanate (MDI), 1, 5-Naphthalene Diisocyanate (NDI) and dimethylbiphenyl diisocyanate (TODI). 1 to 10 mol%, preferably 1 to 5 mol%, more preferably 3 mol mol% of sodium carboxymethylcellulose.

In the invention, the thermal polymerization time is 1-3 h, preferably 2h, and the polymerization temperature is 70-90 ℃, preferably 80 ℃.

The preparation method of the silicon anode comprises the following steps:

and weighing silicon powder and a conductive additive with certain mass, putting the silicon powder and the conductive additive into a carboxymethyl cellulose sodium derivative water-based binder aqueous solution containing a carbamate structural unit, uniformly stirring, coating the mixture on a copper foil, and drying to obtain a pole piece for standby.

In the invention, the grain diameter of the silicon powder is 60-100 nm, more preferably 80nm, and the mass ratio of the silicon powder to the conductive additive to the water-based binder is 50-70:30-20:20-10, preferably 60-70:20:20-10, more preferably 60:20:20.

In the invention, the stirring time is 6-12 hours, preferably 7-10 hours, more preferably 8-9 hours, the drying temperature is 60-120 ℃, preferably 70-110 ℃, more preferably 80-100 ℃, and the drying time is 10-15 hours, preferably 12 h.

Example 1

0.2000 G sodium carboxymethylcellulose is dissolved in 10 mL deionized water, and 0.0090 g diphenylmethane diisocyanate is dissolved in 1 mL acetone solution, and then poured into CMC aqueous solution, wherein the molar ratio of sodium carboxymethylcellulose monomer to diphenylmethane diisocyanate is 100:3. Then, the reaction system is reacted at the polymerization temperature of 80 ℃ for 2 h, and finally the sodium carboxymethyl cellulose derivative water-based adhesive solution containing the carbamate structural unit is obtained for standby.

The preparation method of the corresponding lithium ion battery silicon anode material comprises the following steps:

Taking 0.1200 g silicon powder and 0.0400 g Super P in an aqueous solution containing 0.0400 g aqueous binder, fully stirring 8h to obtain uniformly dispersed slurry, uniformly coating the slurry on the surface of a 9 mu m copper foil by a coating machine, drying 12 h at 100 ℃, and finally cutting into round electrode plates with the radius of 7.5 mm for later use.

Example 2

0.2000 G sodium carboxymethylcellulose is taken to be dissolved in 10 mL deionized water, and 0.0150 g diphenylmethane diisocyanate is taken to be dissolved in 1 mL acetone solution, and then the solution is poured into CMC aqueous solution, wherein the molar ratio of sodium carboxymethylcellulose monomer to diphenylmethane diisocyanate is 100:5. Then, the reaction system is reacted at the polymerization temperature of 80 ℃ for 2 h, and finally the sodium carboxymethyl cellulose derivative water-based adhesive solution containing the carbamate structural unit is obtained for standby.

The preparation method of the negative electrode material of the lithium ion battery corresponding to the case comprises the following steps:

Taking 0.1200 g silicon powder (SIC material and hard carbon material) and 0.0400 g Super P in an aqueous solution containing 0.0400 g of the aqueous binder, fully stirring 8 h to obtain uniformly dispersed slurry, uniformly coating the slurry on the surface of a 9-mu m copper foil by a coating machine, drying 12 h at 100 ℃, and finally cutting into round electrode plates with the radius of 7.5mm for later use.

Example 3

0.2000 G sodium carboxymethylcellulose is dissolved in 10 mL deionized water, and 0.0090 g dimethyl diphenyl diisocyanate is dissolved in 1 mL acetone solution, and then poured into CMC aqueous solution, wherein the molar ratio of sodium carboxymethylcellulose monomer to dimethyl diphenyl diisocyanate is 100:3. Then, the reaction system is reacted at the polymerization temperature of 80 ℃ for 2h, and finally the sodium carboxymethyl cellulose derivative water-based adhesive solution containing the carbamate structural unit is obtained for standby.

The preparation method of the negative electrode material of the lithium ion battery corresponding to the case comprises the following steps:

Taking 0.1200 g silicon powder and 0.0400 g Super P in an aqueous solution containing 0.0400 g of the aqueous binder, fully stirring 8 h to obtain uniformly dispersed slurry, uniformly coating the slurry on the surface of a 9 mu m copper foil by a coating machine, drying 12 h at 100 ℃, and finally cutting into round electrode plates with the radius of 7.5 mm for later use.

Example 4

0.2000 G of sodium carboxymethylcellulose is dissolved in 10 mL of deionized water, and 0.0150 of g of dimethylbiphenyl diisocyanate is dissolved in 1 mL of acetone solution, and then poured into CMC aqueous solution, wherein the molar ratio of sodium carboxymethylcellulose monomer to dimethylbiphenyl diisocyanate is 100:5. Then, the reaction system is reacted at the polymerization temperature of 80 ℃ for 2h, and finally the sodium carboxymethyl cellulose derivative water-based adhesive solution containing the carbamate structural unit is obtained for standby.

The preparation method of the negative electrode material of the lithium ion battery corresponding to the case comprises the following steps:

Taking 0.1200 g silicon powder and 0.0400 g Super P in an aqueous solution containing 0.0400 g of the aqueous binder, fully stirring 8 h to obtain uniformly dispersed slurry, uniformly coating the slurry on the surface of a 9 mu m copper foil by a coating machine, drying 12 h at 100 ℃, and finally cutting into round electrode plates with the radius of 7.5 mm for later use.

Example 5

The process procedure of example 1 was followed to prepare an aqueous binder solution of sodium carboxymethylcellulose derivatives containing urethane structural units for use.

The preparation method of the silicon-carbon anode material of the lithium ion battery comprises the following steps:

Taking 0.1200 g silicon carbon material and 0.0400 g Super P in an aqueous solution containing 0.0400 g aqueous binder, fully stirring 8 h to obtain uniformly dispersed slurry, uniformly coating the slurry on the surface of a 9 mu m copper foil by a coating machine, drying 12 h at 100 ℃, and finally cutting into round electrode plates with the radius of 7.5 mm for later use.

Example 6

The process procedure of example 1 was followed to prepare an aqueous binder solution of sodium carboxymethylcellulose derivatives containing urethane structural units for use.

The preparation method of the corresponding hard carbon negative electrode material of the lithium ion battery comprises the following steps:

Taking 0.1200 g hard carbon material and 0.0400 g Super P in an aqueous solution containing 0.0400 g aqueous binder, fully stirring 8 h to obtain uniformly dispersed slurry, uniformly coating the slurry on the surface of a 9 mu m copper foil by a coating machine, drying 12 h at 100 ℃, and finally cutting into round electrode plates with the radius of 7.5 mm for later use.

Comparative example 1

Dissolving 0.4000 g sodium carboxymethyl cellulose in 20 mL deionized water for use.

The preparation method of the negative electrode material of the lithium ion battery corresponding to the case comprises the following steps:

taking 0.1200 g silicon powder and 0.0400 g Super P in an aqueous solution containing 0.0400 g of the polymer, fully stirring 8h to obtain uniformly dispersed slurry, uniformly coating the slurry on the surface of a 9 mu m copper foil by a coating machine, drying 12 h at 100 ℃, and finally cutting into round electrode plates with the radius of 7.5 mm for later use.

And transferring the processed pole piece into a glove box for assembling the button cell.

The cell assembly, negative electrode casing, shrapnel, gasket, lithium sheet counter electrode, separator (Celgard 2400PP film), negative electrode sheet, gasket and positive electrode casing were stacked in sequence in an argon glove box (H 2O/O2 <0.1 ppm), and a proper amount of electrolyte was added dropwise between each step. The electrolyte is 1M LiPF 6 dissolved in EC/DEC (volume ratio 1:1) and 10% FEC film forming additive is added. The assembled cell was placed in a 25 ℃ incubator at 12h for adequate electrolyte infiltration.

FIG. 1 shows the peel performance comparison of the aqueous adhesives used in examples 1 and 2 and comparative example 1. As can be seen from fig. 1, in example 1, compared with example 2 and comparative example 1, the peel strength is greatly improved, which benefits from the fact that the introduction of a proper amount of crosslinking agent promotes the interaction between the adhesive segments, and the network structure constructed by the dynamic-static combined crosslinking mode enhances the adhesive capacity of the aqueous adhesive;

FIG. 2 is a cyclic voltammogram of the secondary lithium cell prepared in example 1 at a sweep rate of 0.05 mV/s. As can be seen from fig. 2, during the multiple scans, intercalation/deintercalation peaks of lithium ions in the silicon material appear at 0.01V, 0.19V, and 0.37V, 0.53V, respectively, indicating that the aqueous covalent cross-linking type binder material of example 1 does not affect the deintercalation process of lithium ions in the battery and can exist stably under the electrochemical window of 0.01-1.5V;

Fig. 3 is a graph comparing the results of cycling at a current density of 2.1A/g for the lithium-ion battery of silicon negative electrode prepared in examples 1,3 and comparative example 1. As can be seen from fig. 3, the battery according to example 1 still has a specific discharge capacity of 1339.7mAh/g after 200 cycles, and exhibits superior cycle performance compared to example 3 and comparative example 1.

Fig. 4 is a graph comparing the results of cycling at a current density of 2.1A/g for the silicon carbon negative lithium battery prepared in example 5 and comparative example 1. As can be seen from fig. 4, the battery according to example 5 exhibited excellent cycle performance after 300 cycles, with a higher discharge specific capacity released than that of comparative example 1.

Fig. 5 is a graph comparing the results of the hard carbon negative lithium battery prepared in example 6 and comparative example 1 cycled at a current density of 2.1A/g. As can be seen from fig. 5, the battery according to example 6 exhibited excellent cycle performance after 800 cycles, with a higher discharge specific capacity released than that of comparative example 1.
